# DevOps Engineer Interview Task

Terraform code review and architecture design exercise for Senior DevOps Engineer candidates.

**Scenario:** A containerized API platform on ECS Fargate with RDS PostgreSQL, fronted by an Application Load Balancer. The code was generated by an AI agent and contains intentional issues at multiple difficulty levels.

**Duration:** 30 minutes | **Format:** Progressive (Triage, Deep-Dive, Architecture Design)

See [INTERVIEW_GUIDE.md](./INTERVIEW_GUIDE.md) for the full interviewer guide, answer key, and scoring rubric.

> **Do not share the contents of this directory with candidates before the interview.** Candidates should see only the `terraform/` directory during the session.
